inclusion / what_hides_it: unverifiable from docs this run. MEASURED (not documented): frontmatter sidebar.hidden:true removes a page from the nav ONLY inside an autogenerate directory, and the page still builds (EXTRA-AUTOGENERATE: o-hidden.md absent from nav, dist/orderprobes/o-hidden/index.html still built). Under the default explicit sidebar config there is NO working hide flag in @astrojs/starlight 0.42.3: P4 tested both frontmatter sidebar.hidden:true and entry-level hidden:true on an explicitly-listed page — the nav link stayed in place both times and the page built; the shipped schema (dist/schemas/sidebar.js) defines no hidden key for explicit entries and the nav code (dist/utils/navigation.js) filters sidebar.hidden only inside treeify(), which serves the autogenerate path. Whether the official docs describe entry-level hidden for explicit links could not be checked.
